key.name: enable-close-by-rules
key.summary: Enable or disable the ability of closing windows by customed rules, such as a shortcut

key.name: windows-mapping
key.summary: The mapping of xid and stable sequence of a window on X11

key.name: close-windows-rules
key.summary: Rules that are used to close applications
key.description: Rules that are used to close applications

key.name: close-windows-rules-by-keyword
key.summary: Rules that are used to close applications by keyword
key.description: Rules that are used to close applications by keyword

key.name: close-windows-whitelist
key.summary: A whitelist that contains apps or windwows that can be closed safely, even they have multiple windows.

key.name: autorestore-sessions
key.summary: Session(s) restored on startup

key.name: enable-autoclose-session
key.summary: Enable to close running apps and windows while Logout, Reboot and Shutdown via endSessionDialog.

key.name: enable-save-session-notification
key.summary: Show a notification when users click buttons on the popup menu to save a session.

key.name: enable-restore-previous-session
key.summary: Enable to Restore previous apps and windows at startup

key.name: enable-autorestore-sessions
key.summary: Enable to restore session(s) on startup
key.description: Enable to restore session(s) on startup and install `~/.config/autostart/_sessionsifu-restore-session.desktop`.

key.name: restore-session-interval
key.summary: The interval restoring applications
key.description: Restore applications at intervals of some milliseconds, up to 5 minutes

key.name: last-automatic-restore-attempt
key.summary: Internal automatic restore crash-loop guard
key.description: Stores the last automatic restore attempt time so a compositor restart cannot immediately repeat the same restore storm.

key.name: restore-at-startup-without-asking
key.summary: Restore at startup without asking
key.description: Restore immediately at startup without asking

key.name: autorestore-sessions-timer
key.summary: Set the timer on the AutostartDialog for some seconds
key.description: Set the timer on the AutostartDialog for some seconds, the upper value is 3600s

key.name: restore-previous-delay
key.summary: Start to restore the previous session after a specified delay
key.description: Start to restore the previous session after a specified delay, the upper value is 3600s

key.name: autostart-delay
key.summary: Autostart delay
key.description: A specified amount of time to delay to execute the target command.

key.name: restore-window-tiling
key.summary: Restore window edge tiling

key.name: raise-windows-together
key.summary: Raise all two windows together
key.description: Raise all two windows together while one of the pairs is raised while tiling.

key.name: stash-and-restore-states
key.summary: Stash and restore states
key.description:
Stash states while Gnome Shell restarts via `Alt+F2 -> r` or `killall -3 gnome-shell`, and restore the windows states after the restart finishes.
Only enabled on X11, since Wayland doesn't support restart on fly.

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show or hide indicator on the panel

key.name: continuous-save-enabled
key.summary: Continuously save rolling desktop snapshots
key.description: Save complete restorable desktop snapshots on a timer. SessionSifu keeps only the five newest snapshots in its dedicated history directory.

key.name: continuous-save-interval
key.summary: Automatic snapshot interval in seconds
key.description: Time between complete rolling desktop snapshots.

key.name: recall-enabled
key.summary: Enable experimental local Privacy Recall
key.description: Record a searchable, sanitized timeline of observable application and window metadata. The feature is disabled by default and never uploads data. Visual previews require a separate explicit opt-in.

key.name: recall-interval
key.summary: Privacy Recall capture interval in seconds

key.name: recall-retention-hours
key.summary: Hours to retain local Privacy Recall entries

key.name: recall-include-file-paths
key.summary: Include open file paths in Privacy Recall
key.description: This separate opt-in is disabled even when Privacy Recall is enabled.

key.name: recall-capture-screenshots
key.summary: Capture local screenshot previews for Privacy Recall
key.description: Separate opt-in for compressed previews. While an excluded application is visible, only eligible per-window previews are saved; previews never leave this device.

key.name: recall-preview-quality
key.summary: Recall screenshot preview quality
key.description: Storage saver uses 960 px, Readable text uses 1440 px and High detail uses 1920 px on the longest edge.

key.name: recall-search-view-mode
key.summary: Recall search result layout
key.description: Remembers either the visual card layout or compact result list.

key.name: recall-ocr-enabled
key.summary: Index screenshot text with local OCR
key.description: Separate opt-in. OCR runs locally after encryption-safe capture finalization.

key.name: recall-semantic-search-enabled
key.summary: Enable related-match ranking
key.description: Separate opt-in for local related-match ranking; no query or snapshot is uploaded.

key.name: recall-semantic-model-path
key.summary: Optional strictly local semantic model directory
key.description: SessionSifu never downloads this model and forces offline loading.

key.name: recall-sensitive-filter
key.summary: Discard captures containing likely sensitive information
key.description: Best-effort local filtering for passwords, payment cards and security codes.

key.name: recall-excluded-websites
key.summary: Websites excluded from Privacy Recall
key.description: Domain suffixes that must not be retained when an observable URL is available.

key.name: recall-storage-quota-mb
key.summary: Maximum encrypted Recall vault size in MiB

key.name: recall-pause-until
key.summary: Unix timestamp until which Recall capture is paused
key.description: Zero means no timed pause; -1 means paused indefinitely.

key.name: recall-excluded-apps
key.summary: Applications excluded from Privacy Recall
key.description: Case-insensitive application identifiers or name fragments, redacted during capture and search.

key.name: recall-search-shortcut-enabled
key.summary: Enable the Privacy Recall search shortcut
key.description: The shortcut can search existing history even while new Recall capture is paused.

key.name: recall-search-shortcut
key.summary: Keyboard shortcut that opens the dedicated Privacy Recall search popup

key.name: debugging-mode
key.summary: Enable or disable the debugging mode
key.description: Enable the debugging mode to see what happened, for debugging or issue reporting or development purpose

key.name: verbose-logging
key.summary: Enable or disable verbose logging
key.description: Enable verbose logging for more informational output like windows position saving, session information etc
